en.title: Lufthansa takes delivery of its first A350-1000, its 700th Airbus aircraft
en.summary: Lufthansa took delivery of its first Airbus A350-1000 in Toulouse on November 10, 2026. Named "Deutschland" and registered D-AIFA, the jet wears a dark blue centenary livery and will be based in Munich, entering service to Tokyo Haneda on December 23.
body: Lufthansa took delivery of its first Airbus A350-1000 aircraft in Toulouse, France, on November 10, 2026. The aircraft, named "Deutschland" and registered D-AIFA, was painted in a special dark blue livery to mark the airline's centennial year. It is also the carrier's 700th Airbus aircraft overall; the German carrier took delivery of its first Airbus, an A300B2, in 1976. It is also Lufthansa's first long-haul aircraft to be fitted with high-speed Starlink broadband connectivity.

The new aircraft has been line-fitted with the new Lufthansa Allegris cabin, featuring 300 seats across four service classes: First, Business, Premium Economy and Economy. It will be based in Munich, from where it will operate its first commercial service on December 23, 2026, to Tokyo-Haneda. Shanghai-Pudong and Singapore-Changi are also among the destinations expected to be served by the new aircraft.

Lufthansa Group currently has 15 A350-1000 aircraft on order. The first batch of 10 was ordered in March 2023, as part of a larger order which also included five A350-900s. The German group also ordered seven 787-9 aircraft from Boeing at the same time. That order was then followed by an incremental order for five additional A350-1000s in December 2024.

It is Lufthansa's first long-haul aircraft fitted with high-speed Starlink broadband connectivity and is line-fitted with the new Lufthansa Allegris cabin with 300 seats across First, Business, Premium Economy and Economy.

The aircraft will be based in Munich and will operate its first commercial service on December 23, 2026, to Tokyo-Haneda; Shanghai-Pudong and Singapore-Changi are also among the expected destinations.

zh.title: 漢莎航空接收首架A350-1000，同時為漢莎集團第700架空中巴士飛機
zh.summary: 漢莎航空11月10日在法國圖盧茲接收首架A350-1000，機名「Deutschland」、註冊號D-AIFA，採百年紀念深藍特別塗裝；新機將駐地慕尼黑，12月23日首飛東京羽田。
body: 漢莎航空11月10日在法國圖盧茲接收首架空中巴士A350-1000，機名為「Deutschland」，註冊號D-AIFA，機身採深藍色特別塗裝，紀念航空公司成立一百週年。這架飛機同時是漢莎集團接收的第700架空中巴士飛機；漢莎首架空中巴士為1976年接收的A300B2。新機也是漢莎首架配備高速Starlink寬頻的長程飛機。
新機裝設漢莎全新Allegris客艙，共300個座位，涵蓋頭等、商務、特選經濟與經濟四個艙等，駐地為慕尼黑，首班商業航班預定12月23日飛往東京羽田，上海浦東與新加坡樟宜也在預定航點之列。
漢莎集團目前共訂購15架A350-1000，首批10架於2023年3月訂購，同批另有5架A350-900，並同時向波音訂購7架787-9，另於2024年12月增購5架A350-1000。
